notes: turbothemes is vendored in vendor/turbothemes (scripts/sync-themes.mjs refreshes it) because pnpm cannot fetch the themes/ sub-folder from every environment; apps still get newer themes at run time. Modules actually used so far: appearance (picker, theme start), release-pipeline (auto-pr, check). Not yet copied: updaters, window-frame, logos, guides-and-docs. The bundle format in docs/FORMAT.md is this app's own (backup-bundle is the pattern, not the code). Core is a plain TS package with no Electron dependency.
